## Port correspondence (for tracking) | `nv-mistralai-megatron` source | Adapted commit in this PR | Coverage | | --- | --- | --- | | [`76d333f84`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron/commit/76d333f8414f3db5c81090b88f13223d0bab4408) Support wide residuals with MTP and MIMO | [`7b1dba62a9`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/6855/commits/7b1dba62a9ff83bc1d62feb543976c28e1eff671) | Full feature port, adapted to the upstream wide-layer subclasses and static `HybridStack` specs. | | [`35bc58149`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron/commit/35bc58149b8eefb54063cc3acf0411b84faa0345) Fix FP32-residual dtype coverage for MTP and MIMO tests | [`5b4f54d6ea`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/6855/commits/5b4f54d6ea7dc1a39d6d7350292fb23a8e00af9f) | MTP/MIMO portion. Combined ShortcutMoE coverage belongs to [4/4, PR #7440](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7440). | | [`092ff0acb`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/nv-mistralai-megatron/commit/092ff0acb1ffe32f0c3345b5a56f321c253d9592) FP32 Residual + WideResidual/ShortcutMoE fixes | [`5b4f54d6ea`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/6855/commits/5b4f54d6ea7dc1a39d6d7350292fb23a8e00af9f) | Partial, test-scenario lineage only: ports the FP32 variants of the GPT+MTP, Hybrid+MTP/replay, and MIMO+wide integration tests. The corresponding ordinary-Transformer and MTP dtype handling is an upstream-specific adaptation rather than a direct code port. Inference dispatch is handled by 1/4, kernel/config support by 2/4, MIMO bridge precision by PR #7480, and ShortcutMoE integration by 4/4. | ## - [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR. # What does this PR do? Adds the MTP and MIMO composition boundaries for the streamwise wide-residual series. The main language decoder may carry a `K * hidden_size` residual stream, while: - MTP shifted-token embeddings and auxiliary layers remain at the ordinary hidden size `D` - text and projected modality activations are composed at `D` before entering the decoder - the combined MIMO activation is expanded exactly once at the main decoder boundary and - the vision tower and projector remain ordinary-width modules. > This is PR 3 of a four-part series and is stacked on [2/4] PR #6805. The [2/4]-to-[3/4] diff contains two commits and 16 files. ## Issue tracking Linked issue: Related to #6716 ## Motivation MTP and MIMO both create boundaries at which a decoder activation cannot simply be assumed to have the main decoder's carried width. MTP combines the completed decoder state with a shifted-token embedding. The decoder state must therefore be read out from `K * D` to `D`, and the MTP embedding and auxiliary stack must also operate at `D`. MIMO first constructs one language-model input by replacing modality placeholder positions with projected image or other modality embeddings. Text embeddings, projector outputs, and the combined tensor all use the language model's ordinary hidden size `D`. Expanding any input before this composition would give the wrapper incompatible widths. The intended lifecycle is: ```mermaid flowchart TB T["Text embeddings
[S, B, D]"] V["Modality encoder
ordinary-width config"] P["Trainable modality projector
output width D"] C["MIMO composition at D
replace modality placeholders"] T --> C V --> P --> C subgraph DEC["Main language decoder"] direction TB E["Expand once
[S, B, D] -> [S, B, K, D]"] W["Wide Transformer / Mamba / MoE stack
optional residual replay at K * D"] R["Final stream readout
[S, B, K, D] -> [S, B, D]"] E --> W --> R end C --> E R --> L["LM head and main loss
width D"] subgraph MTP["Multi-Token Prediction at ordinary width"] direction TB I["Original token IDs"] S["Shifted-token embeddings
[S, B, D]"] A["MTP auxiliary stack
ordinary residual width D"] Q["Cumulative modality-validity mask"] ML["MTP-1 ... MTP-N losses
shared LM head at D"] I --> S --> A --> ML I -. "exclude modality placeholders" .-> Q Q --> ML end R --> A ``` ## Design ### Main decoder and MTP use different stream contracts `HybridStack` now distinguishes the main decoder from an MTP auxiliary stack through `is_mtp_layer`: - the main decoder specializes its branch specs with wide-residual connections, expands its input to `K * D`, optionally performs residual-stream replay, and reads the final state back to `D`; - an MTP stack does not specialize its layers, expand its input, construct a wide readout, or participate in residual-stream replay; and - the MTP marker is propagated to layer construction so every auxiliary-layer form consistently accepts ordinary-width residual states. `TransformerLayer` and `MambaLayer` retain their ordinary residual-size contract when this marker is set. The previous `wide_residual + MTP` rejection is therefore removed. This design deliberately keeps MTP at `D`; it does not create a second wide stream inside each prediction head. MTP and selective residual replay can be enabled together because replay owns only the main decoder's wide boundaries. ### MIMO composes at `D` and expands once MIMO continues to pass its combined activation as `decoder_input`, bypassing the language model's main embedding lookup. The language decoder's `HybridStack` receives that ordinary-width tensor and performs the same single input expansion used by a text-only model. Megatron's checked-in Nemotron MIMO provider derives its language, RADIO vision, and projector configs from the same CLI-populated base config. Its `_make_dense_non_hybrid` helper clears language-only MoE, Mamba, wide-residual, and residual-replay settings from both the vision and projector copies. ViT freezing remains controlled separately by `--freeze-vit`, and the projector config separately sets its output to the language hidden size `D`. Consequently, only the language decoder expands the composed activation to `K * D`. ## Second commit: FP32 residual precision boundaries The second commit, `be43960031`, keeps ordinary Transformer and MTP computation in `params_dtype` while preserving FP32 residual carries, and strengthens BF16-backed FP32 tests. ## Configuration This PR adds no new wide-residual CLI or configuration surface. It makes the existing options from the first two PRs compose with the existing MTP and MIMO configuration. For example: ```python from megatron.core.transformer import WideResidualConfig transformer_config.wide_residual = WideResidualConfig( num_streams=3, learned_retention=True, retention_init=0.999, retention_max_forget=0.10, ) transformer_config.mtp_num_layers = 2 ``` Selective replay from PR 2 remains optional: ```text --recompute-granularity selective --recompute-modules residual_stream --residual-stream-recompute-num-layers 4 ``` In a MIMO model, the wide-residual configuration belongs to the language decoder. The dense vision provider strips it from the modality encoder configuration. ## Contribution process ### Pre-checks - [x] I have added relevant unit tests - [x] I have added relevant functional tests - [x] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html) - [x] I have added relevant documentation - [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR ### Code review Feel free to message or comment @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged! All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft. #### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review" 1. When your PR is ready, click **Ready for Review**. 2. An oncall reviewer is auto-assigned and expert reviewers are notified based on your changes. - Some PRs may jump straight to step 2. This is determined by `.github/CODEOWNERS`. :warning: Only mark as ready once merge-conflicts are resolved and the CI is passing. Final Review might get declined if these requirements are not fulfilled. #### Step 2: Final Review For PRs that change `megatron/core`, once all expert reviewers have approved, the `Final Review` label is applied **automatically** and final reviewers are assigned. For PRs outside `megatron/core`, this step is skipped. #### Step 3: Approved Once all required reviewers have approved, the `Approved` label is applied **automatically**. ### Merge Any member of [mcore-engineers](https://github.com/orgs/NVIDIA/teams/mcore-engineers) will be able to merge your PR.

+    mtp_stack = model.mtp.layers[0].mtp_model_layer
+    assert type(mtp_stack.layers[0]) is TransformerLayer
+    assert mtp_stack.layers[0]._get_self_attention_residual_connection() is None
+    assert not mtp_stack.uses_wide_residual_stream
+    assert model.mtp.layers[0].eh_proj.weight.grad is not None
+    assert all(torch.equal(grad, gathered_grads[0]) for grad in gathered_grads[1:])
